---
title: "Quiz de mathématiques"
params:
  notion: "addition_fractions"
  support: "quiz"
  variantes: 5
output:
  html_document: default
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
banque = eduschool::questions(params$notion)
html = knitr::is_html_output()
# Tirages calcules en R a la publication : aucun interpreteur R dans le navigateur.
tirages = lapply(seq_len(if (html) params$variantes else 1L), function(i) {
  lapply(banque$questions, eduschool::question)
})
```

```{r interactif, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (html) {
  # Ne jamais injecter de contenu editorial directement comme HTML ou JavaScript.
  donnees = jsonlite::toJSON(tirages, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null")
  donnees = gsub("<", "\\\\u003c", donnees, fixed = TRUE)
  donnees = gsub(">", "\\\\u003e", donnees, fixed = TRUE)
  cat('<div id="edu-quiz"><div id="edu-questions"></div>',
      '<button id="edu-valider" type="button">Verifier mes reponses</button> ',
      '<button id="edu-relancer" type="button">Relancer le quiz</button>',
      '<p id="edu-bilan" aria-live="polite"></p></div>\n')
  cat('<script type="application/json" id="edu-donnees">', donnees, '</script>\n', sep = '')
  cat('<script>\n',
'(() => {
  const variantes = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("edu-donnees").textContent);
  const zone = document.getElementById("edu-questions");
  const bilan = document.getElementById("edu-bilan");
  let tour = 0;
  function noeud(type, texte, parent) {
    const el = document.createElement(type);
    el.textContent = texte;
    parent.appendChild(el);
    return el;
  }
  function afficher() {
    zone.replaceChildren(); bilan.textContent = "";
    variantes[tour].forEach((q, i) => {
      const bloc = document.createElement("section");
      bloc.className = "edu-question";
      noeud("h3", (i + 1) + ". " + q.enonce, bloc);
      if (q.propositions && q.propositions.length) {
        q.propositions.forEach((p, j) => {
          const etiquette = document.createElement("label");
          const bouton = document.createElement("input");
          bouton.type = "radio"; bouton.name = "q" + i;
          bouton.value = p; bouton.id = "edu-q" + i + "-" + j;
          etiquette.appendChild(bouton);
          noeud("span", " " + p, etiquette);
          bloc.appendChild(etiquette);
          bloc.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));
        });
      } else {
        const entree = document.createElement("input");
        entree.type = "text"; entree.setAttribute("aria-label", "Votre reponse");
        bloc.appendChild(entree);
      }
      const correction = noeud("div", "", bloc);
      correction.className = "edu-correction";
      correction.hidden = true;
      zone.appendChild(bloc);
    });
  }
  document.getElementById("edu-valider").addEventListener("click", () => {
    let bonnes = 0, total = 0;
    variantes[tour].forEach((q, i) => {
      const bloc = zone.children[i];
      const coche = bloc.querySelector("input[type=radio]:checked");
      const saisie = bloc.querySelector("input[type=text]");
      const valeur = coche ? coche.value : (saisie ? saisie.value.trim() : "");
      const juste = valeur === String(q.reponse).trim();
      if (valeur) { total++; if (juste) bonnes++; }
      const correction = bloc.querySelector(".edu-correction");
      correction.textContent = (juste ? "Bonne reponse. " : "Reponse attendue : " + q.reponse + ". ") +
        (q.correction || "");
      correction.hidden = false;
    });
    bilan.textContent = bonnes + " reponse(s) correcte(s) sur " + variantes[tour].length +
      " (" + total + " reponse(s) fournies).";
  });
  document.getElementById("edu-relancer").addEventListener("click", () => {
    tour = (tour + 1) % variantes.length;
    afficher();
  });
  afficher();
})();\n', '</script>\n', sep = '')
  cat('<style>.edu-question {margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em;border:1px solid #bbb}',
      '.edu-correction {margin-top:.8em;white-space:pre-wrap}',
      '.edu-question label {cursor:pointer}</style>\n')
}
```

```{r imprimable, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!html) {
  for (i in seq_along(tirages[[1L]])) {
    q = tirages[[1L]][[i]]
    cat("\n## Question ", i, "\n\n", q$enonce, "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (length(q$propositions)) {
      for (p in q$propositions) cat("- ", p, "\n", sep = "")
      cat("\n")
    } else cat("\nReponse : ........................................\n\n")
  }
  cat("\n\\newpage\n\n# Corrige\n\n")
  for (i in seq_along(tirages[[1L]])) {
    q = tirages[[1L]][[i]]
    cat("\n## Question ", i, "\n\n**Reponse :** ", q$reponse,
        "\n\n**Correction :** ", q$correction, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
